newsitem.title: DOMINICAN REPUBLIC: 150-year-old turtle killed in Dominican Republic.
newsitem.headline: 150-year-old turtle killed in Dominican Republic.

text.p: A giant turtle estimated to be 150 years old was beaten to death by vandals who attacked it with sticks, officials of the Dominican Republic's National Aquarium said on Friday.

Nicknamed Mochita (Stumpy), the turtle had been a familiar figure in Haina, south of Santo Domingo, where it had been seen regularly for at least 20 years slowly making its way to the beach to lay its eggs.
Mochita was estimated to weigh about 600 pounds (272 kg).
